text:
Ashley: Hey all, I'm blocked on onboarding. Trying to create a service account in the dev project but gcloud fails with PERMISSION_DENIED. I also can't link the project to the dev billing account. Can someone point me to who can grant the rights? I'm trying to set up CI that pushes images and creates a GKE cluster in asia-southeast1.

onboarding-bot: Hi Ashley! Welcome :tada: — please check the new-hire checklist: https://redwood.example/onboarding. If you're blocked on permissions we'll loop in cloud-ops.

Maya - cloud-ops: Hi Ashley — can you paste the project ID and the exact error? Also what's your Okta email so I can look up your principal?

Ashley: Project id is redwood-dev-sandbox-asia. Error when I run `gcloud iam service-accounts create ci-runner --project redwood-dev-sandbox-asia` is:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.iam.service-accounts.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: The caller does not have permission
```
Also `gcloud alpha billing projects link redwood-dev-sandbox-asia --billing-account BILL-DEV-001` returns permission denied. My okta email is ashley@redwood.com.

Maya - cloud-ops: Thanks. Looks like org policy is preventing SA creation and you also don't have billing permissions. I'll check the org policy for that folder — sometimes we have `constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountCreation` set for sandbox projects. Two things I can do: 1) temporarily grant you `roles/editor` on that project so you can create SA and enable APIs (preferred short fix), or 2) file an infra ticket to relax the org policy for this project if it's a legitimate dev sandbox use case. Which do you prefer?

Ashley: Temp grant would be great so I can get CI going. If we need it long-term happy to sign whatever compliance doc.

Maya - cloud-ops: Cool. @Maya will do the grant but I need approval from finance to attach to billing. @Sam - finance can you confirm cost center so we can link BILL-DEV-001?

Sam - finance: Hi — for billing we need the project id, cost center, and manager approval message in the ticket. Cost center for Ashley's team is CC-ENG-42. Please include any expected spend estimate if you expect > $200/month. Once that's in the ticket I'll link BILL-DEV-001.

Jordan - devex: I can help with the AWS side (ECR push). We usually set up a cross-account role in the infra account named `RedwoodDev-Push` and grant `sts:AssumeRole` to your principal. Jordan here — Ashley, can you confirm your IAM principal (the gcp principal is ashley@redwood.com; for AWS we map Okta to `okta/ashley@redwood.com`)? I can pre-create the role and policy so you can push once the GCP side is sorted.

Ashley: Yep, AWS principal is okta/ashley@redwood.com. Also quick q: is asia-southeast1 allowed? I tried to create a GKE cluster and got `permission denied: compute.resourceAccess` earlier.

Maya - cloud-ops: asia-southeast1 is allowed for sandbox, but you need `roles/compute.admin` to create clusters (or we can create the cluster for you). I'll put the temporary `roles/editor` on the project which includes compute bits. After you confirm CI works I'll remove the temp elevated role and we can switch to least-privilege IAM for the SA.

Ashley: Amazing, thanks everyone — I'll wait for the ticket update and try after the grant. :thumbsup:
